author: Mantercmg
body:
Hey, guys.

I've built around three or two ma ps by now, but they all were rejected. EDIT:you can skip my ramble on about nebula maps. But anyway, I have ran out of map building ideas and need new ones. I've found that the new nebula maps lack earth, as in, dirt. It might just be me, but i think that some of the old classics have been deleted. Like, say for instance, Volcano. I loved that map, but now i cant seem to find it. 

But anyway, my love of classics aside, do think nebula maps recently are lacking something, even if you don't what kind of maps would you want to see on nebula?

I might build a map based on one of the themes you say. Others can build maps based on the comments here (If any). 

You can also put maps down for nexus and the walls (JUST MAKE SURE TO MARK THEM AS WHATEVER THEIR CATEGORY IS, AS IN [NEXUS] or [WALLS])

replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
A bit off topic here but every old map (except Checkmate, Haze, Gladiator, Valley of the Dead and Ravaged) can be found in their respective rotations (either Left (Small) rotations, Middle (Large) rotations or Right (MCZone) rotations.)

Back on topic, I don't really care about the theme. As long as the map plays good (like Rendezvous, it's looks might not be the best, but the gameplay is amazing. Another example would be Quintus as well).
